text:
gina: starting a focused 'keychain' recert this afternoon (3pm PT). scope: admin roles inactive >30d, KMS grants with non-org principals, and service accounts only referenced by nightly jobs. creating evidence tickets only; no auto-revoke. :spiral_notepad:
omar: Quick ask 0 0 can we include a terraform-tracked vs manual-binding diff? infra-managed bindings should route to infra owners first.
gina: yes, pipeline will tag infra-tracked vs infra-untracked and route accordingly. infra-untracked go to principal email + access-cert-steward cc.
nick: For KMS prioritization, please surface external principals (domains not @redwood) and keys with decrypt activity from unknown actors. Also mark keys with rotation_recent=true as manual-only.
sec-bot: recert-scan rc-20260412-03 started at 2026-04-12T22:00:05Z. collecting IAM, KMS grants and SA usage. will post summary when done.
oncall-ops: heads-up 0 owner emails often cause noisy pages when aliases are oncall. recommend X-Notify-Policy:quiet header for known oncall aliases and rate-limit 50/hr.
policy: add a small note for reviewers: if log coverage is partial (archived projects) escalate to the project owner to provide evidence; don't auto-revoke on partial logs.
omar: quick gcloud snippet for recent decrypts to embed in tickets:
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --limit=200 --freshness=90d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp, resource.labels.key_name)'
```
use that to tag keys with recent activity as low-priority.
sec-bot: collection finished at 2026-04-12T22:07:48Z 0 scanned: 2,870 bindings, 78 KMS grants, 37 cron-only SAs, 54 admin roles inactive>30d. creating 92 owner-evidence tickets.
gina: plan recap: 1) tickets created (evidence only) 2) 72h response window 3) escalate ownerless items to oncall for manual remediation 4) final manual revoke only by oncall with runbook checklist. volunteers: @omar query tuning, @nick runbook KMS notes, @policy escalation template.
omar: I'll assemble a short dry-run revoke report after owner responses and post here for signoff before any manual action.
gina: thanks all. will post ticket summary in the morning and tag owners. :thumbsup:
